## Appearance

Anne is a tall, slender woman with large, expressive gray eyes and a pale, delicate complexion. Her once-red hair has darkened with age into a rich, glossy auburn. She possesses a charming, graceful figure and an expressive face that brightens vividly with her emotions.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P13](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0013), [v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014), [v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v2 c1 P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058), [v3 c33 P13](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0013)_

## Personality

Anne is an imaginative, romantic, and deeply passionate individual who finds joy in the beauty of nature and human relationships. She possesses a lively sense of humor, a vivid inner life, and a strong sense of duty and loyalty. Though impulsive and prone to dramatic romanticizing, she learns to be practical, thoughtful, and deeply sympathetic to the sorrows of others.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014), [v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c5 P5](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0005), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v3 c14 P29](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0029), [v3 c38 P8](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0008), [v4 c8 P10](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0010)_

## History

Anne Shirley, an orphan from Nova Scotia, was mistakenly sent to Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert of Green Gables, who decided to keep her. She grew up in Avonlea, making lifelong friendships with Diana Barry and others, and eventually attended Queen's Academy where she earned her teaching license and the Avery Scholarship. After teaching in Avonlea to remain near Marilla following Matthew's death, she attended Redmond College in Kingsport, graduating with High Honors in English. During her college years she rejected a romantic proposal from Roy Gardner and realized her true love for her childhood rival and friend, Gilbert Blythe. After serving as principal of Summerside High School for three years, Anne married Gilbert and moved to their 'house of dreams' at Four Winds Harbor. Though she suffered the heartbreak of losing her first baby, Joy, she later gave birth to a healthy son, James Matthew (Jem), and eventually moved with her family to Ingleside in Glen St. Mary.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c32 P40](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0040), [v1 c38 P20](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0020), [v3 c36 P7](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0007), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029), [v3 c38 P18](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0018), [v3 c41 P24](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0024), [v4 c1 P4](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0004), [v4 c4 P15](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0015), [v4 c5 P17](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0017), [v4 c19 P10](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0010), [v4 c19 P24](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0024), [v4 c34 P2](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0002), [v4 c40 P58](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0058), [v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000)_

## Background by volume

- Orphaned at three months old after both her parents died of fever  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013)</sub>
- Brought up in poverty, working as a child-minder before entering an asylum  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)</sub>
- Adopted by Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert of Green Gables at age eleven  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c5 P10](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0010), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005)</sub>
- Attended Queen's Academy and Redmond College, winning the Avery and Thorburn scholarships  <sub>[v1 c32 P40](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0040), [v3 c31 P10](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0010), [v3 c36 P7](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0007)</sub>
- Taught school at Avonlea and Summerside High School  <sub>[v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v4 c1 P4](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0004)</sub>
